# WO-214: i18n string inventory refresh (dashboard + monitor)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Nora assigns
Agent: docs
Source: CLAUDE-048 (docs/i18n/STRINGS.md last updated before today's UI)

## Goal
Bring docs/i18n/STRINGS.md and docs/i18n/GLOSSARY_ES.md up to date with user-visible strings added since they were written: the "Is this you?" card and its flash messages (src/freemyid/wizard/dashboard.py, server.py MSGS), the Assisted card and proof inputs, and the monitor plain-text output (cli.py).

## Acceptance criteria
- Every new user-visible string listed with file:line, context (where it appears), and any placeholder; mark strings that carry a safety/consent meaning so translators keep them exact.
- Glossary: Spanish terms for any new privacy concepts (possible match, confirm it's you, practice mode, approval) with a short rationale; plain, respectful usted register.
- Docs only; no product edits.

## Allowed paths
- `docs/i18n/STRINGS.md`
- `docs/i18n/GLOSSARY_ES.md`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests -k "i18n or doc"`
